method: Isometric per-triangle islands, longest edge horizontal, sorted shelf packing. Actor scale baked into geometry, actor reset to 1. No shared islands even between material slots. UV0 sampled unchanged by material.
exceptions: Terrain, sea, lake and surf use continuous world-space procedural shading; no prop density target. Tiny plant faces can be subpixel at 32px/m. Triangle seams are deliberately numerous; no claim of hand-painted seam continuity. Non-power-of-two originals are kept unchanged, using no mips.
